summary: PS International Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency letter dated August 12, 2026, for failing to maintain the minimum market value of listed securities (MVLS) of $35 million over 30 consecutive business days. The company also does not meet alternative listing standards under Nasdaq rules. It has a 180-day compliance period until February 8, 2027, to regain compliance, requiring MVLS to close at $35 million for ten consecutive business days. The notice has no immediate delisting effect; shares continue trading under PSIG. The company will monitor and consider options, but no assurance exists. This is a routine regulatory notification, not a special situation.
